summary: Shaarli is a lightweight, database-free bookmarking and link-sharing tool written in PHP. It allows you to save, tag, and share web links from a self-hosted interface without relying on external services. Because it avoids traditional database engines, it offers a streamlined deployment path for personal archive management.
goodFor: Users who want a fast, self-contained bookmark manager running on standard PHP infrastructure without the overhead of maintaining a separate database.
watchOut: Without a traditional database backend, scaling to very large archives or handling concurrent write operations may present limitations compared to alternatives.
deployNotes: You will typically need a standard web server like Apache or Nginx configured to run PHP, along with persistent storage to maintain your flat-file data.
